description: Cross-conversion fidelity proof (WU-15, flagship demo #1), request leg: a recorded openai/chat_completions request (system turn + function tools + a full tool round) converts to an anthropic/messages request through the canonical backbone — the planner's 2-hop path, no direct edge. The merged per-edge report is the product: hop 1 (audit decode) re-threads the sibling `role: tool` wire message as a canonical tool turn (relocation) and banks the wire `model` in extensions['openai.model'] (routing data, never canonical content, 3.4); hop 2 (Messages encode) hoists the leading system turn to the top-level `system` field (relocation — the signature move of the destination dialect), threads the tool turn as a `role: user` wire message (relocation), and honestly DROPS the foreign extension (no Messages encode lane for the bag yet). Note the openai wire has no is_error lane at all, so a recorded openai request can never carry the flag — the is_error drop is pinned by the reverse-direction fixture. expect carries the destination `model` member as the harness's bind_resource injection, below the graph (WU-05a): converting re-binds a fresh resource at the front door.
